warmup.cue: Bell tight around the head, elbows in. Ribs down — don't arch.
Pass the bell around your hips. Stay square, don't sway.
Opposite arm and leg. Slow. Hips stay level.
One bell at your side. Stand tall, don't lean away.

rounds.cue: Bell locked overhead, eyes on it. Hinge at the hip, not the spine.
rounds.stop: Elbow bends or you round over

rounds.cue: Arm straight up, biceps by your ear. Drive knees to hip height.
Drag the bell under you. Hips FROZEN — that's the whole exercise.
Rotate through the ribs, arms just carry the bell.
rounds.stop: You twist from the low back

rounds.cue: Chest tall, rotate under control. Heels can stay down.

cooldown.cue: Low back glued to the floor. Slow exhale as you extend.
Ribs down, low back pressed flat. Small range is fine.
Stack the hips. Drive the knee to the elbow.
